sentenceSets.sentence: His homespun delivery concealed the sophistication of his argument, reaching audiences that academic language would have lost.

answerChoices.reasoning: Colloquial means using informal, conversational language, which is related to homespun but doesn't necessarily imply the rustic, simple quality that also characterizes homespun communication.

Folksy means having the character of folk traditions or simple country people, which overlaps closely with homespun but may emphasize sentimentality more than authentic simplicity.
